# Saturation

> > Saturation is a film production budgeting and financial management platform with integrated tax incentive tracking, payroll tools, and SAG-AFTRA compliant templates.

Founded by Jens Jacob and used on productions like After Death and The Heart of Man, Saturation provides production accountants and producers with comprehensive budgeting software, legal agreement templates, and tax credit resources across all U.S. states. The platform integrates with Wrapbook for payroll management and offers educational content on filmmaking craft and industry practices.

## Key Topics

- Film budgeting software
- Production management
- SAG-AFTRA union agreements
- Film tax incentives and credits
- Payroll management (Wrapbook integration)
- Production accountant workflow
- Budget templates (feature, micro-budget, post-production)
- Film production agreements and contracts
- Micro-budget filmmaking
- Cinematography and film stock (Kodak Portra, Ilford)
- Visual storytelling techniques
- Analog vs digital filmmaking
- Producer roles and responsibilities
- Film financing and tax credits
- Industry legal documents

## Budgeting Tools & Templates

- [Free SAG Feature Film Budget Template](https://saturation.io/templates/sag-feature-film): SAG-AFTRA Feature Film Budget Template with union rates and ULBA structure
- [Free Post Production Budget Template](https://saturation.io/templates/post-production): Post Production Budget Template for film, TV & media budgeting phase
- [Micro Budget Film: The Complete Guide](https://saturation.io/blog/micro-budget-film): Micro budget film guide: SAG-AFTRA rules, financing & budgeting tools

## Platform Integrations

- [Wrapbook Integration](https://saturation.io/integrations/wrapbook): Wrapbook payroll integration for Saturation actualization and data import

## Production Finance & Legal

- [Essential Film Production Agreements Every Producer Needs](https://saturation.io/blog/essential-film-production-agreements-every-producer-needs): Film production agreement templates for contracts and legal documents guide
- [Understanding Who Budgets a Film](https://saturation.io/blog/understanding-who-budgets-a-film): Film budgeting roles, key players, tax credits & financial planning guide
- [How To Work With Your Production Accountant](https://saturation.io/blog/how-to-work-with-your-production-accountant): Production accountant collaboration guide for filmmaking finance workflow
- [What Does a Film Producer Do? Roles and Pay](https://saturation.io/blog/what-does-a-film-producer-do): Film producer roles, responsibilities, salary ranges & career path guide

## Tax Incentives & Credits

- [Montana Film Tax Credit 2026](https://saturation.io/tax-incentives/montana): Montana MEDIA Act SB326: 20-30% transferable film tax credits through 2045
- [Katie Pryor Film Commission](https://saturation.io/blog/katie-pryor-film-commission): Katie Pryor Film Commission: Louisiana film production support & incentives

## Cinematography & Film Craft

- [What Is Film Stock Definition](https://saturation.io/blog/what-is-film-stock-definition): Film stock definition covering Kodak Portra, Technicolor history & analog texture
- [What Is Surrealism Definition](https://saturation.io/blog/what-is-surrealism-definition): Surrealism art movement definition with André Breton and Salvador Dalí context
- [What Is A Spaghetti Western Definition](https://saturation.io/blog/what-is-a-spaghetti-western-definition): Spaghetti Western definition: Sergio Leone's Italian Western genre explained
